phases.description: HOLLIS holds NAOMI's look, quite still

questions.question: 0-0.5s SETUP: does this happen on screen - HOLLIS looks at NAOMI?
0.5-4.3s ACTION: does this happen on screen - HOLLIS speaks to NAOMI sharply?
4.3-6s HOLD: does this happen on screen - HOLLIS holds NAOMI's look, quite still?
Happens exactly once (not repeated or looped): HOLLIS speaks to NAOMI
HOLLIS: does the face/body read as forceful, wary (restrained)? Must NOT read as: calm.
Line 640 is audible, spoken by the right character, lips match: HOLLIS: Sounded like a threat. Moreno, did that sound like one?
HOLLIS sounds like the voice bible: low, gravelly male voice; no reference take yet (the first accepted speaking take becomes it)
Planned size CLOSE, EYE_LEVEL, STATIC: does the take match?

First frame matches state SC05_g22: Continues from the previous shot: HOLLIS standing behind the counter; NAOMI standing at the counter, frame-left; ELI standing by the door, frame-right; the brown packet: lying sealed under HOLLIS's right hand, red seal up; the ledger: lying closed on the counter; the ID card: in HOLLIS's pocket.

Last frame matches state SC05_g23: Continues from the previous shot: HOLLIS standing behind the counter; NAOMI standing at the counter, frame-left; ELI standing by the door, frame-right; the brown packet: lying sealed under HOLLIS's right hand, red seal up; the ledger: lying closed on the counter; the ID card: in HOLLIS's pocket.
Identity, wardrobe, set and light stable; no morphing, extra limbs, text artefacts or flicker.
Motion is physically plausible and smooth (full clip, not stills).
Corners (all four, full size): any watermark, logo, sparkle or text? Name it and its corner. The known Gemini sparkle bottom-right is recorded, not removed (Owner decision); any other mark fails.
Line 640: does HOLLIS clearly speak to NAOMI (eyes and body toward them)?
Is the place where NAOMI stands kept out of frame (never shown empty), and do HOLLIS's eyes go to frame-left, well clear of the lens?
Does HOLLIS look at NAOMI and never into the lens?
Do ELI and HOLLIS stay on their own sides (frosted-glass hallway door / counter, staff side and archive shelves) the whole clip?

instructions: Fill checks[] (result, severity on FAIL, level, evidence, reviewer human:<id>), then `film.py review --film DIR --ingest FILE`. Leave a group UNASSESSED if you did not look.
